The Theocratic Threat
The Bible is a horrific chronicle of carnage and atrocity, housing a
cacophony of contradictory voices. While it contains sporadic
utterances of peace and charity, its overarching narrative leans
heavily toward autocracy, violence, and total control. We cannot
divorce a belief system from the text that founds it.
Those who attempt to impose these autocratic, bronze-age beliefs
upon an entire society with the force of law are the enemies of
personal liberty. The danger of theocracy is not a relic of the past;
it remains a lively and present threat to the open society.
